summary: This candidate is a distinct micro-skill (asset_level 3) that implements the inner computational loop of vector space scoring. While peer candidates cover higher-level workflow skills (asset_level 2) for overall document ranking and cosine similarity, this skill focuses specifically on the term-at-a-time score accumulation algorithm—a lower-level, reusable component. It has clear support from the reference material, no conflicts, and provides granular implementation guidance that complements but does not duplicate the peer candidates. The micro-skill level and specific focus on accumulator updates make it a valuable distinct capability.
